ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Online class sessions will be held May 19, 26, June 2, 16, 23, July 7, 21, and 28 from 6:30 to 9:30pm central time. Course lab dates held at the University of Illinois Department of Crop Sciences will be on Saturdays May22, June 12, July10, July31 from 9am to 3pm central time. Online scheduled class sessions require that each student have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions.
